assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia, occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting.
This medical necessity aligns with diagnoses I47.1 and I25.10.
This supports the medical necessity required to reverse denial CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
